verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's docs say all /api endpoints authenticate with private API keys that carry API key scopes. Those scopes exist to limit what third parties can access, and a Custom option lets you decide how much access to grant. OAuth is also offered as a more secure alternative for apps, so issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent is clearly supported. missing for 10: a granular scope catalog (per-resource read/write detail), evidence tying scoped credentials to the MCP server or agent use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
